A better way
across campus.

This is an independent student presentation prototype inspired by the Uber ride experience and campus transit planning.

All buses, routes, stops and travel times are simulated. Street traces follow the bundled 2014 UA reference map. Walking corridors and building entrances are illustrative where the map lacks sidewalk detail. Building labels are illustrative, and this map should not be used for real navigation.

Try Presidential Village → Student Center, choose a route, and follow the bus. The simulation starts at 3× speed with a Next demo stage control to skip ahead during your presentation. Pause, change speed, or reset using the map controls.

Current location is a demo starting point. This prototype does not request GPS access, call external APIs, reserve seats, or connect to TripShot. The interface uses a system-font fallback for Uber Move.
